items.title: 101 Malicious npm Packages Add Developers' WhatsApp Accounts to Groups Without Consent
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have identified a cluster of 101 npm packages that are used to trap developers into a WhatsApp group subscriber campaign dubbed PhantomSub.
